en.s: The eclipse of Thales was a solar eclipse, which was, according to the ancient Greek historian Herodotus (writing about 150 years later), accurately predicted by the Greek philosopher Thales of Miletus. If Herodotus's account is accurate, this eclipse is the earliest recorded as being known in advance of its occurrence. According to Herodotus, the change of day into night was interpreted as an omen, and interrupted a battle in a long-standing war between the Medes and the Lydians in Anatolia (present-day Turkey). The only solar eclipse matching the presumed place, era, and conditions of visibility necessary to explain the historical event is the eclipse of 28 May 585 BC.

zh.s: 泰勒斯日食是一次日全食。古希腊历史学家希罗多德（他写作时距事件约150年）称，米利都哲学家泰勒斯准确预言了这次日食。如果希罗多德的记述属实，这是最早有记录的事前预言日食事件。希罗多德还说，白昼突然变黑被视为预兆，并中断了安纳托利亚（今土耳其）米底人和吕底亚人长期战争中的一场战斗。要符合历史记载中推测的地点、时代和可见条件，只有公元前585年5月28日这次日食。

en.s: The Battle of Hulao, (Chinese: 虎牢之戰) or Battle of Sishui (汜水之戰, Wade–Giles: Ssŭ Shui), was a decisive Tang victory over the rival Zheng and Hebei-based Xia polities during the transition from Sui to Tang. The battle took place during the Luoyang–Hulao campaign on 28 May 621 when a Xia army – led by Dou Jiande, ruler of Xia – was defeated attacking a smaller Tang army – led by Prince Li Shimin – entrenched at the strategic Hulao Pass.

zh.s: 虎牢之战（中文：虎牢之戰）又称汜水之战，是唐朝在隋唐交替时期击败郑和河北夏政权的一场决定性胜利。621年5月28日，夏军在虎牢—洛阳战役期间进攻李世民亲王率领、驻守战略要地虎牢关的一支规模较小的唐军，结果战败。夏军由夏政权统治者窦建德率领。

en.s: The Battle of Koppam was fought between the Medieval Chola kings Rajadhiraja Chola I and Rajendra Chola II with the Chalukya king Someshvara I in 1054, or in 1052 according to Sen. Though the Cholas were successful in the battle, the king and supreme commander, Rajadhiraja I lost his life in the battlefield and was succeeded to the throne by his younger brother, Rajendra Chola II.

en.s: The Battle of Brindisi (1156) was fought by the Byzantine Empire and the Kingdom of Sicily over control of Southern Italy. The battle was part of a Byzantine campaign orchestrated by the emperor Manuel I Komnenos to recover Apulia and Calabria for the Byzantine Empire by taking advantage of the chaotic political situation in Norman Sicily following the death of Roger II and the succession of William 'the Bad'.

zh.s: 1156年5月28日，拜占庭帝国与西西里王国为争夺意大利南部的控制权交战。布林迪西之战是拜占庭皇帝曼努埃尔一世发动的收复阿普利亚和卡拉布里亚战役的一部分；他趁诺曼西西里在罗杰二世去世、威廉“恶人”继位后局势混乱之际发起了这场战役。

en.s: The Avignonet massacre occurred on the eve of 28 May 1242 when a small force, mainly consisting of Cathars, massacred a group of inquisitors during the Albigensian Crusade. Guillaume Arnaud and Etienne de Saint-Thibery, the chief inquisitors of the County of Toulouse were visiting Avignonet. Arnaud and Saint-Thibery were lodged at the castle of Raymond VII, Count of Toulouse.

zh.s: 阿维尼奥内大屠杀发生于1242年5月28日前夜。阿尔比十字军东征期间，一支以卡特里派为主的小部队屠杀了一群宗教裁判官。图卢兹伯国的首席宗教裁判官纪尧姆·阿尔诺和埃蒂安·德·圣蒂贝里当时正在访问阿维尼奥内，住在图卢兹伯爵雷蒙七世的城堡中。

en.s: The Spanish assault on Djerba was a 1520 Spanish military expedition against the island of Djerba in Tunisia. Led by Hugo of Moncada, it ended with the capitulation of the island's sheikh, who became a tributary of Emperor Charles V.

The site of the battle is in present-day Gifu city, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. It was a battle between Saitō Dōsan and his son, Saitō Yoshitatsu, who had instigated a coup d'etat.

en.s: The Storming of Bolton, sometimes referred to as the "Bolton massacre", was an event in the First English Civil War which happened on 28 May 1644. The strongly Parliamentarian town was stormed and captured by Royalist forces under Prince Rupert. It was alleged that up to 1,600 of Bolton's defenders and inhabitants were slaughtered during and after the fighting. The "massacre at Bolton" became a staple of Parliamentarian propaganda.

zh.s: 博尔顿突袭战又称“博尔顿大屠杀”，是第一次英国内战期间发生的一起事件，时间为1644年5月28日。鲁珀特亲王率领保王党军队攻占了坚定支持议会派的博尔顿镇。据称，战斗期间及之后多达1,600名守军和镇民遭屠杀。“博尔顿大屠杀”后来成为议会派宣传中的常见说法。

en.s: The Battle of Smolenice (Hungarian: Szomolányi csata, German: Schlacht bei Smolenitz, Slovak: Bitka pri Smoleniciach) was a battle between the Kuruc (a group of Hungarian peasants), and the forces of the Habsburg Empire, soldiers of the Holy Roman Empire and auxiliaries from Denmark. The battle occurred on May 28, 1704, at Smolenice in Upper Hungary (present day Slovakia), where the Kuruc army routed the Habsburg forces, capturing the Austrian commander. For a short time, the rebels threatened the safety of Vienna, marauding through a number of villages in Lower Austria, Marchfeld, and Moravia.

zh.s: 斯莫莱尼斯战役（匈牙利语：Szomolányi csata，德语：Schlacht bei Smolenitz，斯洛伐克语：Bitka pri Smoleniciach）是库鲁茨起义军（一支匈牙利农民武装）与哈布斯堡帝国军队、神圣罗马帝国士兵及丹麦援军之间的一场战斗。战斗于1704年5月28日在上匈牙利的斯莫莱尼斯（今斯洛伐克）发生，库鲁茨军击溃哈布斯堡军队并俘获奥地利指挥官。短时间内，叛军一度威胁到维也纳，并在下奥地利、马奇费尔德和摩拉维亚多地劫掠。

en.s: On May 28, 1754, provincial troops led by George Washington and Mingo warriors led by Tanacharison ambushed a French Canadian force at Jumonville Glen, in present-day Pennsylvania, United States.

zh.t: 华盛顿率部在朱蒙维尔峡谷伏击法国军队
zh.s: 1754年5月28日，乔治·华盛顿率领的殖民地部队与塔纳查里森率领的明戈族战士在朱蒙维尔峡谷伏击一支法属加拿大军队。战场位于今美国宾夕法尼亚州境内。

en.s: The Battle of Enniscorthy was a land battle fought on 28 May 1798, during the Irish Rebellion of 1798. An overwhelming force of rebels assailed the town of Enniscorthy, County Wexford, which was defended only by a 300-strong garrison supported by loyalist civilians. On the previous day at nearby Oulart, several thousand rebels led by Father John Murphy had massacred a detachment of the North Cork militia, amounting to 110 officers and men.

zh.s: 恩尼斯科西战役是1798年爱尔兰起义期间的一场陆战，于1798年5月28日发生。大批起义军攻打韦克斯福德郡恩尼斯科西镇，当地只有约300名守军和保皇派平民防守。前一天，在附近的奥拉特山，约翰·墨菲神父率领的数千名起义者屠杀了北科克民兵队的110名军官和士兵。

en.s: The Battle of Rathangan was a military engagement between the forces of the British Crown and the United Irishmen during the 1798 rebellion. On 24 May 1798 a group of rebels from the United Irishmen led by a Captain Doorley attacked the town of Rathangan, County Kildare, which was being defended by a small corps of yeomanry led by Captain James Spencer; the rebels held the town for four days.

zh.s: 拉塔甘战役是1798年爱尔兰起义期间英国王室军队与联合爱尔兰人之间的一场军事冲突。1798年5月24日，联合爱尔兰人组织的一支起义队伍由杜利上尉率领，袭击基尔代尔郡拉塔甘镇；当地由詹姆斯·斯宾塞上尉率领的一小队自耕农民兵防守。起义军占领该镇四天。

en.s: The Battle of Mileto took place during the War of the Fourth Coalition on 28 May 1807 in Calabria. The Bourbon Kingdom of Sicily attempted to re-conquer its possessions in continental Italy, known as the Kingdom of Naples. The battle ended in a victory for French forces under general Jean Reynier.

zh.s: 米莱托战役发生于第四次反法同盟战争期间，时间为1807年5月28日，地点在卡拉布里亚。两西西里王国的波旁王朝试图重新夺回其在意大利半岛的领地，即那不勒斯王国。法国军队在让·雷尼耶将军指挥下获胜。

en.s: The Battle of La Chincúa was a battle of the War of Mexican Independence that occurred from 19 April through 28 May 1813 at a ranch at Tonalá, Chiapas. The battle was fought between the royalist forces loyal to the Spanish crown, commanded by General Miguel Dambrini, and the Mexican rebels fighting for independence from the Spanish Empire, commanded by Mariano Matamoros y Guridi.

zh.s: 拉钦库阿战役是墨西哥独立战争期间的一场战斗，于1813年4月19日至5月28日在恰帕斯州托纳拉的一处牧场发生。交战双方是效忠西班牙王室、由米格尔·丹布里尼将军指挥的保王军，以及由马里亚诺·马塔莫罗斯·伊·古里迪指挥、争取脱离西班牙帝国独立的墨西哥起义军。

en.s: The action off James Island was a naval engagement of the War of 1812. In May 1813 an American frigate captured three British whalers off James Island in the South Pacific. Only one of the whalers resisted and the resultant single-ship action was one of the few fought in Pacific waters during the war. The British later recovered all the whalers involved.

zh.s: 1813年5月，一艘美国护卫舰在南太平洋詹姆斯岛附近俘获三艘英国捕鲸船。只有一艘捕鲸船抵抗，随之发生的单舰交战是这场战争中少数发生在太平洋水域的战斗之一。英国后来夺回了所有涉事捕鲸船。

en.s: The Indian Removal Act of 1830 was signed into law on May 28, 1830, by United States president Andrew Jackson. The law, as described by Congress, provided "for an exchange of lands with the Indians residing in any of the states or territories, and for their removal west of the river Mississippi".

zh.s: 美国总统安德鲁·杰克逊于1830年5月28日签署《印第安人迁移法》。美国国会称，该法规定与居住在各州或领地的印第安人交换土地，并将他们迁往密西西比河以西地区。

en.s: The Treaty of Aigun was an 1858 treaty between the Russian Empire and Qing dynasty of China. Yishan, official of the Qing, signed it on behalf of the Qing. It established much of the modern border between the Russian Far East and China by ceding much of Manchuria (the ancestral homeland of the Manchu people), now known as Northeast China.

zh.s: 瑷珲条约是俄罗斯帝国与清朝于1858年签订的一项条约。清朝官员奕山代表清廷签署条约。条约划定了俄国远东与中国之间的大部分现代边界，并将大片满洲土地（满族人的祖居地，即今天的中国东北）割让给俄国。

Robert E. Lee's Army of Northern Virginia during the American Civil War. zh.s: 霍斯商店之战（又称伊农教堂之战）于 1864 年 5 月 28 日在弗吉尼亚州汉诺威县爆发，是美国内战期间尤利西斯·S·格兰特中将领导的联邦军在陆路战役中对抗罗伯特·E·李将军北弗吉尼亚军团的一场战斗。格兰特在北安娜河战役（5 月 23 日至 26 日）陷入僵局后，再次大幅绕向李军右翼，借帕蒙基河掩护部队向西南移动。李军直接向南推进，在托托波托莫伊溪南岸设防。南方邦联将领派韦德·汉普顿少将率骑兵搜集格兰特下一步行动的情报。

Johnston fought a series of battles between May 25 and June 3 along a front stretching northeast from Dallas toward Acworth, Georgia. At Dallas a probe launched by William B.

zh.s: 达拉斯之战（1864 年 5 月 28 日）是美国内战亚特兰大战役中的一场交战。威廉·特库姆塞·谢尔曼率领的联邦军与约瑟夫·E·约翰斯顿率领的南方邦联军，于 5 月 25 日至 6 月 3 日在一条从佐治亚州达拉斯向东北延伸至阿克沃思的战线上连续交战。在达拉斯，威廉·B·贝特和威廉·希克斯·杰克逊率领的南方邦联师发动试探性攻击，意外演变成对约翰·A·洛根第十五军团防线的全面进攻。进攻被击退，南方邦联军损失惨重。此前联邦军在新希望教堂和皮克特磨坊的失利，有时也与达拉斯之战合称一场战役。

en.s: The Paris Commune (French: Commune de Paris, pronounced [kɔ.myn də pa.ʁi]) was a French revolutionary government that seized power in Paris on 18 March 1871 and controlled parts of the city until 28 May 1871. During the Franco-Prussian War of 1870–1871, the French National Guard had defended Paris, and working class radicalism grew among its soldiers.

en.s: The semaine sanglante ("Bloody Week") was a weeklong battle in Paris from 21 to 28 May 1871, during which the French Army recaptured the city from the Communards. This was the final battle of the Paris Commune. Following the Treaty of Frankfurt and France's loss in the Franco-Prussian War, on 18 March the new French government under Prime Minister Adolphe Thiers attempted to remove a large number of cannons from a park in Montmartre, to keep them out of the hands of the more radical soldiers of the Paris National Guard.

zh.s: “流血周”（法语：semaine sanglante）是1871年5月21日至28日在巴黎发生的一周战斗。法国军队在战斗中从公社社员手中夺回城市，这也是巴黎公社的最后一场战斗。普法战争中法国战败并签署《法兰克福条约》后，3月18日，阿道夫·梯也尔领导的新政府试图从蒙马特一处公园移走大量大炮，避免落入巴黎国民自卫军中更激进的士兵手中。

en.s: The Battle of Frenchman's Butte, fought on May 28, 1885, occurred when the Alberta Field Force attacked a force of Cree, dug in on a hillside near Frenchman's Butte. The battlefield is located in what was then the District of Saskatchewan of the North-West Territories, now the province of Saskatchewan.

zh.s: 法国人丘战役发生于1885年5月28日。当时阿尔伯塔野战部队袭击了一支在法国人丘附近山坡上固守的克里族部队。战场位于当时西北地区的萨斯喀彻温区，如今属于萨斯喀彻温省。

en.s: The Battle of Alapan was fought on May 28, 1898 and was the first military victory of Emilio Aguinaldo after his return to the Philippines from Hong Kong. After American naval victory of the Battle of Manila Bay, Aguinaldo returned from exile in Hong Kong, reconstituted the Philippine Revolutionary Army, and fought against a small garrison of Spanish troops in Alapan, Imus, Cavite. The battle lasted for five hours, from 10:00 A.M. to 3:00 P.M. After the victory at Alapan, Aguinaldo unfurled the Philippine flag for the first time, and hoisted it at the Teatro Caviteño in Cavite Nuevo (present-day Cavite City) in front of Filipino revolutionaries and more than 270 captured Spanish troops.

zh.s: 阿拉潘战役于1898年5月28日打响，是埃米利奥·阿吉纳尔多从香港返回菲律宾后取得的首场军事胜利。马尼拉湾海战中美国海军获胜后，阿吉纳尔多结束流亡回国，重组菲律宾革命军，并在甲米地省伊穆斯的阿拉潘与一小队西班牙驻军交战。战斗持续五小时，从上午10时到下午3时。获胜后，阿吉纳尔多首次展开菲律宾国旗，并在卡维特新城（今卡维特市）的卡维特尼奥剧院升旗，现场有菲律宾革命者和270多名被俘西班牙士兵。

en.s: The Battle of Tsushima was the final naval battle of the Russo-Japanese War, fought on 27–28 May 1905 in the Tsushima Strait. A devastating defeat for the Imperial Russian Navy, the battle was the only decisive engagement ever fought between modern steel battleship fleets and the first in which wireless telegraphy (radio) played a critically important role.

en.t: The first Isle of Man TT race is held
en.s: The Isle of Man TT (Tourist Trophy) races are an annual motorcycle racing event held on the Isle of Man in May and June of mostly every year since its inaugural race in 1907. The two-week event is sanctioned by the Auto-Cycle Union, which also organises the event. The Manx government owns the rights to and promotes the event.

zh.t: 首届曼岛TT摩托车赛举行
zh.s: 曼岛TT（旅游奖杯赛）是一项每年在曼岛举行的摩托车赛事，大多在5月和6月举行，自1907年首届比赛以来一直如此。这项为期两周的赛事由英国汽车俱乐部（Auto-Cycle Union）批准并组织，曼岛政府拥有赛事权利并负责推广。

zh.s: 葡萄牙于1911年5月28日举行制宪议会选举。葡萄牙共和党获胜，在234个席位中赢得229席。

en.s: The Battle of Mastara was a military battle fought by the Armenian National Council and the Ottoman Empire between 24 and 28 May 1918, and was one of the battles that resulted in the formation of the First Republic of Armenia.

zh.s: 马斯塔拉战役于1918年5月24日至28日发生，是亚美尼亚国民委员会与奥斯曼帝国之间的一场战斗，也是促成亚美尼亚第一共和国成立的战役之一。

en.s: The Battle of Cantigny, fought May 28, 1918, was the first major American battle and offensive of World War I. The U.S. 1st Division, the most experienced of the five American divisions then in France and in reserve for the French Army near the village of Cantigny, was selected for the attack.

zh.s: 康蒂尼战役于1918年5月28日打响，是美国在第一次世界大战中的第一场大型战役和进攻。美军第一师是当时驻法五个师中经验最丰富的一个，原本在康蒂尼村附近作为法军预备队，后被选中参加此次进攻。

en.s: Azerbaijan, officially the Republic of Azerbaijan, is a landlocked country at the boundary of Western Asia and Eastern Europe. It is a part of the South Caucasus region and is bounded by the Caspian Sea to the east, Russia's republic of Dagestan to the north, Georgia to the northwest, Turkey (via the exclave of Nakhchivan) and Armenia to the west, and Iran to the south.

zh.t: 阿塞拜疆人民共和国成立
zh.s: 阿塞拜疆，正式名称为阿塞拜疆共和国，是一个内陆国家，位于西亚和东欧交界处，属于南高加索地区。该国东临里海，北邻俄罗斯达吉斯坦共和国，西北接格鲁吉亚，西邻土耳其（通过纳希切万飞地）和亚美尼亚，南接伊朗。

en.s: The 28 May 1926 coup d'état, sometimes called 28 May Revolution or, during the period of the authoritarian Estado Novo (English: New State), the National Revolution (Portuguese: Revolução Nacional), was a military coup of a nationalist origin, that put an end to the unstable Portuguese First Republic and initiated the Ditadura Nacional (National Dictatorship), later refashioned into the Estado Novo, an authoritarian dictatorship that would last until the Carnation Revolution in 1974. The chronic political instability and government's neglect of the army created opportunities for military plots. Already in 1925 there were two failed coup attempts on April 18 and July 19.

zh.s: 1926年5月28日政变有时也称“5月28日革命”。在独裁政权“新国家”（Estado Novo）时期，它被称为“民族革命”（葡萄牙语：Revolução Nacional）。这场民族主义军事政变结束了动荡的葡萄牙第一共和国，开启了“国民独裁”（Ditadura Nacional），后来改组为独裁政权“新国家”，并一直持续到1974年康乃馨革命。政治长期不稳、政府忽视军队，为军事政变提供了机会。1925年就曾发生过两次未遂政变，分别在4月18日和7月19日。

en.t: Volkswagen, the German automobile manufacturer, is founded
en.s: Volkswagen (German pronunciation: [ˈfɔlksˌvaːɡŋ̍] ), commonly abbreviated to VW, is a German automobile brand based in Wolfsburg, Lower Saxony, Germany. Established in 1937 by the German Labour Front, it was revived after World War II by British Army officer Ivan Hirst and, over the 81 years since, grew into the global brand it is today. As of 2025, the company had a market capitalization of approximately US$58.9 billion.

zh.t: 德国汽车制造商大众汽车成立
zh.s: 大众汽车（德语发音：[ˈfɔlksˌvaːɡŋ̍]），通常简称VW，是一家总部位于德国下萨克森州沃尔夫斯堡的汽车品牌。公司由德国劳工阵线于1937年创立，二战后由英国陆军军官伊万·赫斯特重建，在此后81年间发展为如今的全球品牌。截至2025年，公司市值约为589亿美元。

en.s: The 1939 Greek Cup final was the 3rd final of the Greek Cup. The match took place on 28 May 1939 at Leoforos Alexandras Stadium. The contesting teams were AEK Athens and PAOK. It was AEK Athens' second Greek Cup final in their 15 years of existence and PAOK's first ever Greek Cup final in their 13-year history. It was the first Cup final to be held after 6 years.

zh.s: 1939年希腊杯决赛是该项赛事第三届决赛，于1939年5月28日在亚历山大大道球场举行。参赛双方是雅典AEK和塞萨洛尼基PAOK。这是成立15年的雅典AEK第二次打进希腊杯决赛，也是成立13年的PAOK首次闯入决赛；此前六年间没有举行过杯赛决赛。

en.s: The Battle of the Ypres–Comines Canal was a battle of the Second World War fought between the British Expeditionary Force (BEF) and German Army Group B during the BEF's retreat to Dunkirk in 1940. Part of the Battle of Belgium and the much larger Battle of France, it started in the afternoon of 26 May and reached its maximum intensity on 27 and 28 May.

en.s: The Battle of the Lys (French: Bataille de la Lys, Dutch: Leieslag) was a major battle between Belgian and German forces during the German invasion of Belgium of 1940 and the final major battle fought by Belgian troops before their surrender on 28 May. The battle was the bloodiest of the 18 Days' Campaign. The battle was named after the Leie (French: Lys), the river at which the battlefield occurred.

en.t: Second World War: Belgium surrendered to Nazi Germany, ending the Battle of Belgium
en.s: The invasion of Belgium or Belgian campaign (10–28 May 1940), formed part of the larger Battle of France, an offensive campaign by Germany during the Second World War. It took place over 18 days in May 1940 and ended with the German occupation of Belgium following the surrender of the Belgian Army. On 10 May 1940, Germany invaded Luxembourg, the Netherlands, and Belgium under the operational plan Fall Gelb (Case Yellow).

zh.s: 比利时战役（1940年5月10日至28日）是第二次世界大战法国战役的一部分，是德国发起的一场进攻。战事持续18天，以比利时军队投降、德国占领比利时告终。1940年5月10日，德国按照“黄色方案”入侵卢森堡、荷兰和比利时。

en.s: The Second Battle of Kharkov or Operation Fredericus was an Axis counter-offensive in the region around Kharkov against the Red Army Izium bridgehead offensive conducted 12–28 May 1942, on the Eastern Front during World War II. Its objective was to eliminate the Izium bridgehead over Seversky Donets or the "Barvenkovo bulge" (Russian: Барвенковский выступ, romanized: Barvenkovsky vystup) which was one of the Soviet offensive's staging areas.

zh.s: 1944年葡萄牙杯决赛是1943—44赛季葡萄牙杯的最后一场比赛，也是该项赛事第六个赛季。葡萄牙杯是葡萄牙足球联合会（FPF）主办的葡萄牙顶级足球杯赛。比赛于1944年5月28日在里斯本萨莱西亚斯球场举行，参赛双方是葡超球队本菲卡和葡萄牙乙级联赛球队埃斯托里尔。

en.s: The 1947 Avon by-election was a by-election held during the 28th New Zealand Parliament in the Christchurch electorate of Avon. The by-election occurred following the death of MP Dan Sullivan and was won by John Mathison.

en.s: The Copa del Generalísimo 1950 final was the 48th final of the King's Cup. The final was played at Estadio Chamartín in Madrid, on 28 May 1950, being won by Atlético de Bilbao, who beat Real Valladolid 4–1 after extra time.

zh.s: 1950年佛朗哥杯决赛是西班牙国王杯第48届决赛，于1950年5月28日在马德里的查马丁球场举行。毕尔巴鄂竞技在加时赛后以4比1击败皇家巴利亚多利德。

en.s: The 1950 Greek Cup final was the 8th final of the Greek Cup. The match took place on 28 May 1950 at Leoforos Alexandras Stadium. The contesting teams were AEK Athens and Aris. It was AEK Athens' fifth Greek Cup final and third consecutive in their 26 years of existence and Aris' fourth Greek Cup final in their 36-year history.

zh.s: 1950年希腊杯决赛是该项赛事第八届决赛，于1950年5月28日在亚历山大大道球场举行。参赛双方是雅典AEK和阿里斯。这是成立26年的雅典AEK第五次闯入希腊杯决赛，也是成立36年的阿里斯第四次打进决赛。

en.s: The 1955 Victorian state election was held in the Australian State of Victoria on Saturday, 28 May 1955 to elect 65 (of the 66) members of the state's Legislative Assembly. The incumbent Labor Party Government was defeated by the Liberal and Country Party (LCP) led by Henry Bolte with a swing of 14.6%. The Liberal party would hold power until 1982.

zh.s: 澳大利亚维多利亚州于1955年5月28日星期六举行州选举，改选州立法议会66席中的65席。由工党领导的现任政府被亨利·博尔特领导的自由党和乡村党击败，选票向自由党和乡村党倾斜14.6个百分点。该联盟执政至1982年。

en.s: The attack on El Uvero was an armed confrontation between the 26th of July Movement and the Cuban military on May 28, 1957, part of the Cuban Revolution. It was the first major confrontation between the 26th of July Movement, led by Fidel Castro, and the Cuban military, led by Fulgencio Batista, since the latter settled in Sierra Maestra.

zh.s: 埃尔乌韦罗袭击发生于1957年5月28日，是古巴革命期间七二六运动与古巴军队之间的一次武装冲突。这是菲德尔·卡斯特罗领导的七二六运动在其势力进入马埃斯特腊山脉后，与富尔亨西奥·巴蒂斯塔领导的古巴军队发生的首次重大交战。

en.s: The Corynthia expedition, also known as the Corinthia invasion or the Corinthia massacre, was a failed armed attack carried out in Uvero near the coast of Cuba and was financed by former president of Cuba, Carlos Prío Socarrás. Due to the revolutionaries being spotted, they were tipped off to the state police (Guardia Rural) which quickly engaged the invading rebels. 16 rebels were killed, and the expedition was ruled a failure.

zh.s: 科林西亚远征，又称科林西亚入侵或科林西亚屠杀，是一场失败的武装袭击，发生在古巴海岸附近的乌韦罗，由古巴前总统卡洛斯·普里奥·索卡拉斯出资。革命者被发现后，消息传到了乡村警察（Guardia Rural），警察迅速与入侵的叛军交战。16名叛军被杀，远征最终被判定失败。

en.s: The 1958 European Cup final was a football match played at the Heysel Stadium in Brussels, Belgium on 28 May 1958 as the conclusion to the 1957–58 European Cup. zh.s: 1958年欧洲冠军杯决赛于1958年5月28日在比利时布鲁塞尔海瑟尔球场举行，是1957—58赛季欧洲冠军杯的决胜比赛。参赛双方是西班牙皇家马德里和意大利AC米兰。皇家马德里此前已连续两届夺冠，是当时唯一赢得过该项赛事的球队。

en.s: The PGM-19 Jupiter was the first nuclear armed, medium-range ballistic missile (MRBM) of the United States Air Force (USAF). It was a liquid-propellant rocket using RP-1 fuel and LOX oxidizer, with a single Rocketdyne LR79-NA (model S-3D) rocket engine producing 150,000 lbf (670 kN) of thrust. It was armed with the 1.44 Mt (6.0 PJ) W49 nuclear warhead. The prime contractor was the Chrysler Corporation.

zh.t: 又一次生物载荷飞行于1959年5月28日发射
zh.s: PGM-19“木星”是美国空军首款携带核弹头的中程弹道导弹。它使用液体推进剂，以RP-1为燃料、液氧为氧化剂，配备一台Rocketdyne LR79-NA（S-3D型）火箭发动机，推力为150,000磅力（670千牛）。导弹搭载当量为1.44百万吨（6.0拍焦）的W49核弹头，主承包商为克莱斯勒公司。

en.s: Elections were held in the Australian state of Queensland on 28 May 1960 to elect the 78 members of the state's Legislative Assembly. The election followed the enactment of the Electoral Districts Act 1958, which increased the Assembly from 75 to 78 seats and modified the zonal system first established by Labor ahead of the 1950 election.

zh.s: 澳大利亚昆士兰州于1960年5月28日举行选举，选出州立法议会78名议员。选举在《1958年选区法》通过后举行，该法将议会席位从75席增至78席，并修改了工党在1950年选举前首次设立的分区制度。

en.t: Peter Benenson's article The Forgotten Prisoners is published in several internationally read newspapers. This will later be thought of as the founding of the human rights organization Amnesty International
en.s: Peter Benenson (born Peter James Henry Solomon; 31 July 1921 – 25 February 2005) was a British barrister, human rights activist and the founder of the human rights group Amnesty International (AI); a global movement that claims to have more than 10 million members in over 150 countries and territories, who campaign to end abuses on human rights and to secure the release of political prisoners.

zh.t: 彼得·本南森的文章《被遗忘的囚犯》在多家国际报纸刊出，后来被视为国际特赦组织的创立起点
zh.s: 彼得·本南森（出生名彼得·詹姆斯·亨利·所罗门；1921年7月31日—2005年2月25日）是英国律师和人权活动家，也是人权组织国际特赦组织（AI）的创始人。该组织自称是全球性运动，在150多个国家和地区拥有超过1,000万名成员，致力于制止侵犯人权行为并争取释放政治犯。

en.t: The Soviet Kosmos 5 satellite is launched
en.s: Kosmos 5 (Russian: Космос 5 meaning Cosmos 5), also known as 2MS #2 and occasionally in the West as Sputnik 15, was a scientific research and technology demonstration satellite launched by the Soviet Union in 1962. It was the fifth satellite to be designated under the Kosmos system, and the third spacecraft to be launched as part of the MS programme, after Kosmos 2 and Kosmos 3.

zh.s: “宇宙5号”（俄语：Космос 5），也称2MS #2，在西方有时被称为“人造卫星15号”，是苏联于1962年发射的一颗科学研究和技术验证卫星。它是以“宇宙”系列命名的第五颗卫星，也是MS项目发射的第三艘航天器，前两艘是“宇宙2号”和“宇宙3号”。

en.s: The Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO; Arabic: منظمة التحرير الفلسطينية, romanized: ) is a Palestinian nationalist coalition that is internationally recognized as the official representative of the Palestinian people in the occupied Palestinian territories. It is currently represented by the Palestinian Authority based in the West Bank city of Al-Bireh. Founded in 1964, it initially sought to establish an Arab state over the entire territory of the former Mandatory Palestine, advocating the elimination of Israel.

zh.t: 巴勒斯坦解放组织成立
zh.s: 巴勒斯坦解放组织（PLO；阿拉伯语：منظمة التحرير الفلسطينية）是巴勒斯坦民族主义联盟，国际社会承认其为被占领巴勒斯坦领土内巴勒斯坦人民的正式代表。目前，组织由设在约旦河西岸比雷赫市的巴勒斯坦权力机构代表。该组织成立于1964年，最初主张在原英国委任统治的巴勒斯坦全境建立阿拉伯国家，并倡导消灭以色列。

en.s: Elections were held in the Australian state of Queensland on 28 May 1966 to elect the 78 members of the Legislative Assembly of Queensland. The major parties contesting the election were the Country Party led by Premier Frank Nicklin in coalition the Liberal Party, the Labor Party led by Jack Duggan. The Country-Liberal coalition won a fourth term in office at the election.

zh.s: 澳大利亚昆士兰州于1966年5月28日举行选举，选出昆士兰州立法议会78名议员。主要参选政党包括由州长弗兰克·尼克林领导、与自由党联合执政的乡村党，以及由杰克·达根领导的工党。乡村党—自由党联盟第四次连任执政。

en.s: Operation Hickory was a search and destroy operation conducted by the 3rd Marine Division in the area around Con Thien, Quảng Trị Province known as Leatherneck Square from 18 to 28 May 1967. Operation Hickory was the first authorized incursion into the Vietnamese Demilitarized Zone (DMZ).

zh.s: 山核桃行动是美国海军陆战队第三师于1967年5月18日至28日在广治省康天周边“皮颈广场”地区开展的一次搜剿行动。这是美军首次获准进入越南非军事区（DMZ）。

en.s: On 28 May 1968, Garuda Indonesian Airways Flight 892, a scheduled international passenger flight from Jakarta to Amsterdam with stopovers in Singapore, Bangkok, Bombay, Karachi, Cairo, and Rome, crashed during the climb-out after take-off from Santa Cruz Airport for the flight's Bombay to Karachi leg. The Convair 990A jet airliner operating the flight went down at Bilalpada village near Nala Sopara, killing all 29 people on board and one person on the ground.

zh.s: 1968年5月28日，印尼鹰航892号班机从雅加达飞往阿姆斯特丹，途中经停新加坡、曼谷、孟买、卡拉奇、开罗和罗马。在从孟买飞往卡拉奇的航段中，飞机从圣克鲁斯机场起飞爬升时坠毁于纳拉索帕拉附近的比拉尔帕达村。执飞的康维尔990A客机上29人全部遇难，地面还有一人死亡。

en.s: AC Milan defeated Ajax 4–1 in the European Cup final at the Santiago Bernabéu Stadium in Madrid, Spain, on May 28, 1969.

zh.s: 1969年5月28日，AC米兰在西班牙马德里的伯纳乌球场以4比1击败阿贾克斯，赢得欧洲冠军杯决赛。

en.s: The Ulster Workers' Council (UWC) strike was a general strike that took place in Northern Ireland between 15 May and 28 May 1974, during "the Troubles". The strike was called by unionists who were against the Sunningdale Agreement, which had been signed in December 1973. Specifically, the strikers opposed the sharing of political power with Irish nationalists, and the proposed role for the Republic of Ireland's government in running Northern Ireland The strike was organised and overseen by the Ulster Workers' Council and Ulster Army Council, which were formed shortly after the Agreement's signing.

zh.t: 阿尔斯特工人委员会罢工
zh.s: 阿尔斯特工人委员会（UWC）罢工是1974年5月15日至28日在北爱尔兰发生的一次总罢工，正值“北爱尔兰问题”期间。反对《桑宁代尔协议》的统一派人士发起罢工。该协议于1973年12月签署，罢工者尤其反对与爱尔兰民族主义者分享政治权力，以及爱尔兰共和国政府参与治理北爱尔兰。罢工由阿尔斯特工人委员会和阿尔斯特军队委员会组织并监督；这两个组织都是在协议签署后不久成立的。

en.s: The Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS) was created by the Treaty of Lagos on May 28, 1975, in Lagos, Lagos State, Nigeria. ECOWAS was established to promote cooperation and integration in order to create an economic and monetary union for promoting economic growth and development in West Africa.

zh.s: 西非国家经济共同体（ECOWAS）于1975年5月28日在尼日利亚拉各斯州拉各斯市通过《拉各斯条约》成立。该组织旨在促进合作与一体化，建立经济和货币联盟，推动西非经济增长与发展。

en.s: On May 28, 1975, a school shooting occurred at Brampton Centennial Secondary School in Brampton, Ontario, Canada. The perpetrator, 16-year-old Michael Slobodian, a student at the school, shot and killed two people and injured 13 others before committing suicide.

zh.t: 布兰普顿百年中学枪击案
zh.s: 1975年5月28日，加拿大安大略省布兰普顿的布兰普顿百年中学发生枪击事件。凶手是该校16岁学生迈克尔·斯洛博迪安，他开枪打死两人、打伤13人，随后自杀。

en.s: The 1975 European Cup final was a football match between Bayern Munich of West Germany and Leeds United of England, played on 28 May 1975 at the Parc des Princes in Paris. It was the final match of the 1974–75 season of Europe's premier cup competition, the European Cup. Bayern Munich were appearing in their second final; they had won the previous season's competition, beating Spanish team Atlético Madrid 4–0 in a replay after the first match finished 1–1.

zh.s: 1975年欧洲冠军杯决赛于1975年5月28日在巴黎王子公园球场举行，由西德拜仁慕尼黑对阵英格兰利兹联。这是1974—75赛季欧洲顶级俱乐部杯赛的最后一场比赛。拜仁第二次闯入决赛；上赛季他们曾在首场比赛1比1战平后，通过重赛以4比0击败西班牙马德里竞技夺冠。

en.s: The Beverly Hills Supper Club fire in Southgate, Kentucky, is the third deadliest nightclub fire in U.S. history. It occurred on the night of May 28, 1977, during the Memorial Day holiday weekend. A total of 165 people died and more than 200 were injured as a result of the blaze. It was the deadliest fire in the United States since 1944, when 168 people were killed in the Hartford circus fire in Hartford, Connecticut.

zh.t: 比佛利山晚餐俱乐部火灾
zh.s: 肯塔基州绍斯盖特的比佛利山晚餐俱乐部火灾是美国历史上死亡人数第三多的夜总会火灾。火灾于1977年5月28日晚、阵亡将士纪念日假期周末期间发生，共造成165人死亡、200多人受伤。这是美国自1944年以来死亡人数最多的一场火灾；1944年康涅狄格州哈特福德马戏团火灾造成168人死亡。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in the Republic of Upper Volta on 14 May 1978, with a second round on 28 May after no candidate won more than 50% in the first round. They were the country's first multi-party presidential elections, the previous elections in 1965 having Maurice Yaméogo as the sole candidate. They were also the first presidential elections held under a revised Constitution adopted a year earlier.
en.n: This entry records the second round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 上沃尔特共和国于1978年5月14日举行总统选举，首轮无人获得超过50%的选票，因此于5月28日举行第二轮。这是该国首次多党总统选举；此前1965年的选举中，莫里斯·亚梅奥戈是唯一候选人。这也是该国一年前通过修订宪法后举行的首次总统选举。

en.s: The seventh legislative assembly election to Tamil Nadu was held on May 28, 1980. Election was held two years before the end of the term of M. G. Ramachandran administration as it was dissolved by the then President of India Neelam Sanjiva Reddy. Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam allied with the Indian National Congress (Indira) and Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam with Janata Party. Despite their victory at the 1980 Lok Sabha polls, DMK and Indira Congress failed to win the legislative assembly election. ADMK won the election and its leader and incumbent Chief Minister, M. G. Ramachandran was sworn in as Chief Minister for the second time.

zh.t: 1980年泰米尔纳德邦立法议会选举
zh.s: 泰米尔纳德邦第七届立法议会选举于1980年5月28日举行。由于时任印度总统尼拉姆·桑吉瓦·雷迪解散了马·格·拉马钱德兰政府，选举比该届政府任期结束提前两年举行。德拉维达进步联盟与印度国民大会党（英迪拉派）结盟，全印安纳·德拉维达进步联盟则与人民党结盟。尽管两党在1980年人民院选举中获胜，德拉维达进步联盟和英迪拉派国大党仍未赢得本次邦议会选举。全印安纳·德拉维达进步联盟获胜，其党魁、时任首席部长拉马钱德兰第二次宣誓就任首席部长。

en.s: Nottingham Forest defeated Hamburg 1–0 in the European Cup final at the Santiago Bernabéu Stadium in Madrid, Spain, on May 28, 1980.

zh.s: 1980年5月28日，诺丁汉森林在西班牙马德里的伯纳乌球场以1比0击败汉堡，赢得欧洲冠军杯决赛。

en.s: The 1981 UAE President's Cup final was the 5th final of the UAE President's Cup, the Emirati football cup competition. The match was contested by Al Shabab and Al Ain on 28 May 1981. Al Shabab lifted the trophy for the first time with a 3–1 victory over Al Ain.

zh.s: 1981年阿联酋总统杯决赛是该项阿联酋足球杯赛第五届决赛，于1981年5月28日举行，由青年队对阵艾因。青年队以3比1击败艾因，首次夺冠。

en.s: A by-election was held for the Australian House of Representatives seat of Bruce on 28 May 1983. This was triggered by the resignation of Liberal Party MP and former Opposition Leader Sir Billy Snedden.

zh.s: 澳大利亚众议院布鲁斯选区于1983年5月28日举行补选。补选因自由党籍议员、前反对党领袖比利·斯内登爵士辞职而举行。

en.s: General elections were held in Barbados on 28 May 1986. The result was a victory for the Democratic Labour Party, which won 24 of the 27 seats. Voter turnout was 76.7%.

zh.s: 巴巴多斯于1986年5月28日举行大选。民主工党获胜，在27个席位中赢得24席。投票率为76.7%。

en.s: The 1986 Greek Cup final was the 42nd final of the Greek Cup. The match took place on 28 May 1986 at the Olympic Stadium. The contesting teams were Panathinaikos and Olympiacos. It was Panathinaikos' sixteenth Greek Cup final in their 78 years of existence and Olympiacos' twenty-third Greek Cup final in their 61-year history.

zh.s: 1986年希腊杯决赛是该项赛事第42届决赛，于1986年5月28日在奥林匹克体育场举行。参赛双方是帕纳辛奈科斯和奥林匹亚科斯。这是成立78年的帕纳辛奈科斯第16次闯入希腊杯决赛，也是成立61年的奥林匹亚科斯第23次打进决赛。

en.s: General elections were held in Malawi on 27 and 28 May 1987. As the country had become a one-party state in 1966, the Malawi Congress Party was the sole legal party at the time. The number of seats in the National Assembly was increased to 112, whilst President-for-life Hastings Banda was able to appoint as many additional members as he saw fit to "enhance the representative character of the Assembly, or to represent particular minority or other special interests in the Republic." In total, over 200 candidates contested the seats, although in 38 there was only a single MCP candidate, who was elected unopposed.

zh.s: 马拉维于1987年5月27日至28日举行大选。该国自1966年起成为一党制国家，当时马拉维大会党是唯一合法政党。国民议会席位增至112席；终身总统海斯廷斯·班达还可酌情任命额外议员，以“增强议会的代表性，或代表共和国中特定的少数群体及其他特殊利益”。共有200多名候选人角逐议席，其中38个席位只有一名大会党候选人参选，因此直接当选。

en.s: The 1988 DFB-Pokal final decided the winner of the 1987–88 DFB-Pokal, the 45th season of Germany's premier football cup. It was played on 28 May 1988 at the Olympiastadion in West Berlin. Eintracht Frankfurt defeated VfL Bochum 1–0 to claim the trophy for the fourth time, also qualifying for the 1988–89 European Cup Winners' Cup and the 1988 DFB-Supercup.

zh.s: 1988年德国杯决赛决出了1987—88赛季德国杯冠军，是德国顶级足球杯赛第45届赛事。比赛于1988年5月28日在西柏林奥林匹克体育场举行。法兰克福以1比0击败波鸿，第四次夺冠，并获得参加1988—89赛季欧洲优胜者杯和1988年德国超级杯的资格。

en.s: The 1988 Soviet Cup final was a football match that took place at the Lenin's Central Stadium, Moscow on May 28, 1988. The match was the 47th Soviet Cup Final and it was contested by FC Metalist Kharkiv and FC Torpedo Moscow. The Soviet Cup winner Metalist qualified for the Cup Winners' Cup first round for the Soviet Union.

zh.s: 1988年苏联杯决赛于1988年5月28日在莫斯科列宁中央体育场举行，是该赛事第47届决赛，由哈尔科夫金属工人和莫斯科鱼雷交锋。金属工人作为苏联杯冠军，获得参加欧洲优胜者杯首轮比赛的资格。

en.s: The 1989 Associate Members' Cup Final, known as the Sherpa Van Trophy for sponsorship reasons, was the 6th final of the domestic football cup competition for teams from the Third Division and Fourth Division. The final was played at Wembley Stadium, London on 28 May 1989, and was contested by Bolton Wanderers and Torquay United.

zh.s: 1989年英格兰联赛杯决赛又称舍尔帕范杯决赛（冠名赞助），是英格兰第三级和第四级球队参加的国内杯赛第六届决赛。比赛于1989年5月28日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由博尔顿流浪者对阵托基联。

en.s: The 1989 Taça de Portugal final was the final match of the 1988–89 Taça de Portugal, the 49th season of the Taça de Portugal, the premier Portuguese football cup competition organized by the Portuguese Football Federation (FPF). The match was played on 28 May 1989 at the Estádio Nacional in Oeiras, and opposed two Primeira Liga sides: Belenenses and Benfica.

zh.s: 1989年葡萄牙杯决赛是1988—89赛季葡萄牙杯的最后一场比赛，也是该项赛事第49个赛季。葡萄牙杯是葡萄牙足球联合会（FPF）主办的葡萄牙顶级足球杯赛。比赛于1989年5月28日在奥埃拉什国家体育场举行，由葡超球队贝伦人和本菲卡对阵。

en.s: General elections were held in Dominica on 28 May 1990. The result was a victory for the Dominica Freedom Party, which won 11 of the 21 seats. Voter turnout was 66.6%, the lowest since universal suffrage was introduced in 1951.

zh.s: 多米尼克于1990年5月28日举行大选。多米尼克自由党获胜，在21个席位中赢得11席。投票率为66.6%，是1951年实行普选以来最低的一次。

en.t: 1990 Football League Second Division play-off final
en.s: The 1990 Football League Second Division play-off final was an association football match which was played on 28 May 1990 at Wembley Stadium, London, between Sunderland and Swindon Town. The match was to determine the third and final team to gain promotion from the Football League Second Division, the second tier of English football, to the First Division.

zh.t: 1990年英格兰足球联赛乙级联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 1990年英格兰足球联赛乙级联赛升级附加赛决赛于1990年5月28日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由桑德兰对阵斯温顿镇，决出最后一支从英格兰第二级别乙级联赛升入甲级联赛的球队。

en.s: The Ethiopian Civil War was a civil war in Ethiopia and present-day Eritrea, fought between the Ethiopian military junta known as the Derg and Ethiopian-Eritrean anti-government rebels from 12 September 1974 to 28 May 1991. The Derg overthrew the Ethiopian Empire and Emperor Haile Selassie in a coup d'état on 12 September 1974, establishing Ethiopia as a Marxist–Leninist state under a military junta and provisional government.

zh.s: 埃塞俄比亚内战发生于1974年9月12日至1991年5月28日，战场涉及埃塞俄比亚及今厄立特里亚。交战双方是名为“德格”的埃塞俄比亚军政府，以及埃塞俄比亚和厄立特里亚的反政府武装。1974年9月12日，德格通过政变推翻埃塞俄比亚帝国和海尔·塞拉西皇帝，建立奉行马克思列宁主义的军政府和临时政府。

en.s: A general election was held in Cambodia between 23 and 28 May 1993. The result was a hung parliament with the Funcinpec Party being the largest party with 58 seats. Voter turnout was 89.56%. The election was conducted by the United Nations Transitional Authority in Cambodia (UNTAC), which also maintained peacekeeping troops in Cambodia throughout the election and the period after it. This remains the last election which was won by a party other than the Cambodian People's Party as the CPP began to dominate Cambodian politics from 1998.

zh.s: 柬埔寨于1993年5月23日至28日举行大选，结果没有任何政党取得多数席位。奉辛比克党以58席成为最大党，投票率为89.56%。选举由联合国柬埔寨过渡时期权力机构（UNTAC）主持，该机构在选举期间及之后都在柬埔寨驻有维和部队。这是柬埔寨人民党自1998年起主导柬埔寨政坛以来，最后一次有其他政党赢得全国大选。

en.s: The 1997 UEFA Champions League final was a football match played at the Olympiastadion in Munich on 28 May 1997 to determine the winner of the 1996–97 UEFA Champions League. The match was contested by two Italian teams: Juventus and Milan. The match made history as it was the first time two clubs from Italy had faced each other in the final.

zh.s: 2003年欧洲冠军联赛决赛于2003年5月28日在英格兰曼彻斯特老特拉福德球场举行，决出2002—03赛季欧洲冠军联赛冠军。参赛双方是意大利球队尤文图斯和AC米兰。这是欧洲冠军联赛决赛首次由两支意大利球队交锋。

en.s: The 2005 Scottish Cup Final was played on 28 May 2005 at Hampden Park in Glasgow and was the final of the 120th Scottish Cup. The final was contested by Celtic and Dundee United. Celtic won the match with an eleventh-minute goal from Alan Thompson.

zh.s: 2005年苏格兰杯决赛于2005年5月28日在格拉斯哥汉普顿公园举行，也是第120届苏格兰杯决赛。参赛双方是凯尔特人和邓迪联。凯尔特人凭艾伦·汤普森在第11分钟打入的进球获胜。

en.s: The 2005 Football League Two play-off final was an association football match played on 28 May 2005 at the Millennium Stadium, Cardiff, between Southend United and Lincoln City. The match determined the fourth and final team to gain promotion from Football League Two, English football's fourth tier, to Football League One.

zh.t: 2005年英格兰足球联赛乙级联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2005年英格兰足球联赛乙级联赛升级附加赛决赛于2005年5月28日在加的夫千年体育场举行，由绍森德联对阵林肯城，决出最后一支从英格兰第四级别乙级联赛升入甲级联赛的球队。

en.s: The 2005 DFB-Pokal final decided the winner of the 2004–05 DFB-Pokal, the 62nd season of Germany's premier knockout football cup competition. It was played on 28 May 2005 at the Olympiastadion in Berlin. Bayern Munich won the match 2–1 against Schalke 04, giving them their 12th cup title.

zh.s: 2005年德国杯决赛决出了2004—05赛季德国杯冠军，是这项德国顶级淘汰赛杯赛的第62届赛事。比赛于2005年5月28日在柏林奥林匹克体育场举行。拜仁慕尼黑以2比1击败沙尔克04，第四次捧杯。

en.s: The 2005 Belgian Cup final, took place on 28 May 2005 between Club Brugge and Germinal Beerschot. It was the 50th Belgian Cup final and was won by Germinal Beerschot.

zh.s: 2005年比利时杯决赛于2005年5月28日举行，由布鲁日俱乐部对阵日耳曼比尔肖特队。这是比利时杯第50届决赛，由日耳曼比尔肖特队获胜。

en.s: The Sicilian regional election of 2006 for the renewal of the Regional Assembly and the Presidency of Sicily was held on 28 May 2006. The election was competed by three competitors: Salvatore Cuffaro, incumbent President and House of Freedoms candidate; Rita Borsellino, candidate of The Union; and Nello Musumeci, MEP elected for the National Alliance and now leader of the autonomist movement Sicilian Alliance. In the end, Cuffaro won the election, despite a heavy loss of support compared with five years before, when he was elected with 59.1% of votes.

zh.s: 2006年西西里自治区选举于5月28日举行，改选自治区议会并选出西西里主席。三名候选人参选：时任主席、自由之家候选人萨尔瓦托雷·库法罗；联盟候选人丽塔·博尔塞利诺；以及民族联盟当选欧洲议会议员、现为西西里联盟自治运动领袖的内洛·穆苏梅奇。最终，库法罗赢得选举，但与五年前当选时59.1%的得票率相比，支持率大幅下滑。

en.s: The 2006 Colombian presidential election was held on 28 May 2006. Álvaro Uribe was re-elected as President of the Republic and will serve another four-year term, starting on 7 August 2006. Uribe obtained 62.20% of the votes, thus surpassing the 50% needed to avoid a runoff against the second place candidate. Following a constitutional amendment enacted by the government, this was the first occasion in over 100 years that a Colombian president was eligible for immediate re-election.

zh.s: 2006年哥伦比亚总统选举于5月28日举行。阿尔瓦罗·乌里韦连任总统，任期四年，自2006年8月7日开始。他获得62.20%的选票，超过50%的门槛，因此无需与第二名候选人进行第二轮投票。由于政府推动修宪，这是哥伦比亚总统一百多年来首次可以立即连任。

zh.t: 2006年英格兰足球联赛乙级联赛升级附加赛决赛

en.s: The 2007 Football League Championship play-off final was an association football match which was played on 28 May 2007 at Wembley Stadium, London, between Derby County and West Bromwich Albion. The match was to determine the third and final team to gain promotion from the Football League Championship, the second tier of English football, to the Premier League.

zh.t: 2007年英格兰足球联赛冠军联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2007年英格兰足球联赛冠军联赛升级附加赛决赛于2007年5月28日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由德比郡对阵西布罗姆维奇，决出最后一支从英格兰第二级别冠军联赛升入英超的球队。

en.s: The 2007 Prince Edward Island general election was held on May 28, 2007. It elected members of the Legislative Assembly of the province of Prince Edward Island, Canada. The incumbent Progressive Conservative government was defeated by the Liberal opposition after holding power for eleven years. The newly formed Green Party captured 3.04% of the vote or 4.44% in ridings they contested, beating out the New Democratic Party for third place.

zh.s: 爱德华王子岛于2007年5月28日举行大选，选出该省立法议会议员。执政11年的进步保守党政府败给自由党。新成立的绿党获得3.04%的选票，在其参选选区中得票率为4.44%，超过新民主党，排名第三。

en.s: A leadership election was held by the Israeli Labor Party on 12 June 2007, to elect the party's new leader, due to internal dissatisfaction with the incumbent chairman Amir Peretz. The winner was Ehud Barak.

en.s: Nepal, officially the Federal Democratic Republic of Nepal, is a landlocked country in South Asia. It is mainly situated in the Himalayas, but also includes parts of the Indo-Gangetic Plain. It borders the Tibet Autonomous Region of China to the north, and India to the south, east, and west, while it is narrowly separated from Bangladesh by the Siliguri Corridor, and from Bhutan by the Indian state of Sikkim.

zh.t: 尼泊尔联邦共和国成立
zh.s: 尼泊尔，正式名称为尼泊尔联邦民主共和国，是南亚内陆国家，主要位于喜马拉雅山脉，也包括部分印度恒河平原。该国北邻中国西藏自治区，南、东、西三面与印度接壤；与孟加拉国仅被西里古里走廊隔开，与不丹则隔着印度锡金邦。

en.s: The Jnaneswari Express derailment occurred on 28 May 2010 in the West Midnapore district of West Bengal, India. It was disputed as to whether sabotage or a bomb caused damage on the railway track, which in turn led to a train's derailment before an oncoming goods train hit the loose carriages resulting in the deaths of at least 141 passengers.

zh.t: 智那斯瓦里快车脱轨事故
zh.s: 智那斯瓦里快车于2010年5月28日在印度西孟加拉邦西梅迪尼布尔县脱轨。事故原因存在争议，有说法认为轨道遭到破坏或炸弹袭击，导致列车脱轨；随后一列迎面驶来的货运列车撞上脱轨车厢，至少141名乘客遇难。

en.s: A referendum on divorce was held in Malta on 28 May 2011. Voters were asked whether they approved of a new law to introduce allow divorces, as at that time, Malta was one of only three countries in the world (along with the Philippines and the Vatican City) in which divorce was not permitted.

zh.s: 马耳他于2011年5月28日举行离婚公投。选民被问及是否赞成通过新法律允许离婚；当时，马耳他与菲律宾和梵蒂冈城并列为全球仅有的三个不允许离婚的国家。

en.s: The 2011 UEFA Champions League final was an association football match played on 28 May 2011 at Wembley Stadium in London that decided the winner of the 2010–11 season of the UEFA Champions League. The winners received the European Champion Clubs' Cup (the European Cup). The 2011 final was the culmination of the 56th season of the tournament, and the 19th in the Champions League era.

zh.s: 2011年欧洲冠军联赛决赛于2011年5月28日在伦敦温布利球场举行，决出2010—11赛季欧洲冠军联赛冠军。获胜队将获得欧洲冠军俱乐部杯（欧洲杯）。这是该项赛事第56个赛季，也是采用“冠军联赛”名称后的第19个赛季。

en.t: 2011 Ilocos Sur's 1st congressional district special election
en.s: A special election for Ilocos Sur's 1st district seat in the House of Representatives of the Philippines was held on May 28, 2011. The special election was called after incumbent representative Ronald Singson resigned on March 7, 2011, after being convicted of drug possession by the Wan Chai District Court in Hong Kong.

zh.t: 2011年南伊罗戈省第一选区国会议员特别选举
zh.s: 菲律宾众议院南伊罗戈省第一选区于2011年5月28日举行特别选举。补选是因为时任众议员罗纳德·辛松辞职；他于2011年3月7日因持有毒品罪被香港湾仔裁判法院定罪。

en.s: The 2011 Football League Two play-off final was an association football match which was played on 28 May 2011 at Old Trafford in Manchester, between Stevenage and Torquay United, to determine the fourth and final team to gain promotion from Football League Two to the League One. The top three teams of the 2010–11 Football League Two season, Chesterfield, Bury and Wycombe Wanderers, gained automatic promotion to League One, while those placed from fourth to seventh position took part in play-offs.

zh.t: 2011年英格兰足球联赛乙级联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2011年英格兰足球联赛乙级联赛升级附加赛决赛于2011年5月28日在曼彻斯特老特拉福德球场举行，由斯蒂夫尼奇对阵托基联，决出最后一支从乙级联赛升入甲级联赛的球队。2010—11赛季排名前三的切斯特菲尔德、伯里和威科姆流浪者直接升入甲级联赛，排名第四至第七的球队则参加升级附加赛。

en.s: The 2010-11 Celtic League Grand Final was the final match of the 2010–11 Celtic League season. The final was won by Munster who defeated Leinster by 19–9 at Thomond Park to claim their third Celtic League title.

zh.s: 2010—11赛季凯尔特人联赛总决赛是该赛季的最后一场比赛。明斯特以19比9击败伦斯特，在汤蒙德公园球场夺冠，第三次捧起凯尔特人联赛冠军奖杯。

en.s: The Arkankergen massacre occurred on 28 May 2012 in the Arkankergen military post in the Alakol District of Kazakhstan on the border with China, near the village of Usharal. Fifteen people were killed. A border guard, Vladislav Chelakh, initially confessed to the murders, but later retracted his confession.

zh.s: 阿尔坎克根大屠杀于2012年5月28日发生在哈萨克斯坦阿拉科尔区、靠近中哈边境的阿尔坎克根军事哨所，地点靠近乌沙拉尔村。共有15人遇难。边防人员弗拉迪斯拉夫·切拉赫最初承认杀人，后来撤回供词。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Egypt between 26 and 28 May 2014. There were only two candidates, former Egyptian defence minister Abdel Fattah el-Sisi and Egyptian Popular Current candidate Hamdeen Sabahi. El-Sisi won the election, which was neither free nor fair, in a landslide victory, having received 97% of votes. The elections were marred by irregularities, repression of el-Sisi's political opponents, and suppression of free speech.

zh.s: 埃及于2014年5月26日至28日举行总统选举，只有两名候选人：前国防部长阿卜杜勒-法塔赫·塞西，以及埃及人民潮流候选人哈姆丁·萨巴希。塞西以97%的得票率大胜。选举既不自由也不公平，期间出现违规行为、打压塞西的政治对手和压制言论自由等问题。

en.s: The 2016 Norfolk Island local election was held on 28 May 2016 to elect the Norfolk Island Regional Council, the local government body of Norfolk Island. This was the first election for the council since the Norfolk Island Legislative Assembly was abolished in 2015 as part of the removal of Norfolk Island's semi-self-governing status.

zh.s: 诺福克岛于2016年5月28日举行地方选举，选出诺福克岛地区委员会成员。2015年，诺福克岛立法议会被废除，岛上半自治地位随之取消；这是此后首次举行地区委员会选举。

en.s: The 2016 Football League Championship play-off final was an association football match which was played on 28 May 2016 at Wembley Stadium, London, between Sheffield Wednesday and Hull City. The match was to determine the third and final team to gain promotion from the Football League Championship, the second tier of English football, to the Premier League.

zh.t: 2016年英格兰足球冠军联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2016年英格兰足球冠军联赛升级附加赛决赛于2016年5月28日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由谢周三对阵赫尔城，决出最后一支从英格兰第二级别冠军联赛升入英超的球队。

en.s: The 2016 UEFA Champions League final was the final match of the 2015–16 UEFA Champions League, the 61st season of Europe's premier club football tournament organised by UEFA, and the 24th season since it was renamed from the European Champion Clubs' Cup to the UEFA Champions League. It was played at the Stadio San Siro in Milan, Italy, on 28 May 2016, between Spanish teams Real Madrid and Atlético Madrid, in a repeat of the 2014 final.

zh.s: 2016年欧洲冠军联赛决赛是2015—16赛季该赛事的最后一场比赛，也是欧足联主办的欧洲顶级俱乐部赛事第61个赛季。赛事从“欧洲冠军俱乐部杯”更名为“欧洲冠军联赛”后，这是第24个赛季。比赛于2016年5月28日在意大利米兰圣西罗球场举行，由西班牙两支球队皇家马德里和马德里竞技交锋。这是2014年决赛的重演。

en.s: The 2016 Pro12 Grand Final was the final match of the 2015–16 Pro12 season. The 2015–16 season was the second with Guinness as the title sponsor and the seventh ever League Grand Final. The final was played between Leinster and Connacht. Connacht claimed their first title, winning on a 20–10 scoreline.

zh.s: 2016年Pro12联赛总决赛是2015—16赛季的最后一场比赛。该赛季是吉尼斯第二次担任冠名赞助商，也是联赛举办的第七届总决赛。伦斯特对阵康诺特，康诺特以20比10获胜，首次夺冠。

zh.t: 2017年英格兰足球联赛乙级联赛升级附加赛决赛

en.s: The 2017 Taça de Portugal final was the final match of the 2016–17 Taça de Portugal, which decided the winner of the 77th season of the Taça de Portugal. It was played on 28 May 2017 at the Estádio Nacional in Oeiras, between Benfica and Vitória de Guimarães. Benfica won the Portuguese Cup for a record 26th time and made its 11th double (record – previously in 2014) by also winning the League.

zh.s: 2017年葡萄牙杯决赛是2016—17赛季该项赛事的决胜比赛，决定第77个赛季的冠军。比赛于2017年5月28日在奥埃拉什国家体育场举行，由本菲卡对阵吉马良斯胜利队。本菲卡第26次夺得葡萄牙杯，创下纪录；同时也第11次赢得联赛和杯赛双冠王，同样刷新纪录。上一次实现这一成绩是在2014年。

en.s: Operation Claw (Turkish: Pençe Harekatı) was a cross-border military operation undertaken by the Turkish Armed Forces (TAF) in Iraq's autonomous Kurdistan Region against the Kurdistan Workers' Party. On the morning of 28 May 2019, Turkish troops fired artillery shells and launched air attacks, followed by border crossings by the Turkish Army and Gendarmerie Special Public Security Command.

zh.s: “爪行动作”（土耳其语：Pençe Harekatı）是土耳其武装部队在伊拉克库尔德斯坦自治区境内针对库尔德工人党展开的跨境军事行动。2019年5月28日上午，土耳其军队先发射炮弹并发动空袭，随后土耳其陆军和宪兵特别公共安全司令部越境进入伊拉克。

en.s: The 2020 CAF Super Cup (officially the Total CAF Super Cup 2020 for sponsorship reasons) was the 29th CAF Super Cup, an annual football match in Africa organized by the Confederation of African Football (CAF), between the winners of the previous season's two CAF club competitions, the CAF Champions League and the CAF Confederation Cup. The match was played between Al Ahly from Egypt, the 2019–20 CAF Champions League winners, and RS Berkane from Morocco, the 2019–20 CAF Confederation Cup winners, at the Jassim bin Hamad Stadium in Doha, Qatar on 28 May 2021.

zh.s: 2020年非洲超级杯又称Total非洲超级杯2020（冠名赞助），是第29届非洲超级杯，由非洲足球联合会（CAF）主办，每年由上赛季非洲冠军联赛和非洲足联联合会杯冠军交锋。比赛于2021年5月28日在卡塔尔多哈的贾西姆·本·哈马德体育场举行，由2019—20赛季非洲冠军联赛冠军、埃及阿赫利对阵联合会杯冠军、摩洛哥贝尔卡内复兴队。

en.s: The 2022 Leinster Senior Football Championship final was played at Croke Park in Dublin on 28 May 2022. It was contested by Dublin and Kildare. Dublin won a 12th consecutive title.

en.s: The 2022 EFL League Two play-off final was an association football match which was played on 28 May 2022 at Wembley Stadium, London, to determine the fourth and final team to gain promotion from EFL League Two, the fourth tier of English football, to EFL League One.

en.s: The 2022 UEFA Champions League final was the final match of the 2021–22 UEFA Champions League, the 67th season of Europe's premier club football tournament organised by UEFA, and the 30th season since it was renamed from the European Champion Clubs' Cup to the UEFA Champions League. It was played at the Stade de France in Saint-Denis, France, on 28 May 2022, between English club Liverpool and Spanish club Real Madrid.

zh.s: 2022年欧洲冠军联赛决赛是2021—22赛季该赛事的最后一场比赛，也是欧足联主办的欧洲顶级俱乐部赛事第67个赛季。赛事从“欧洲冠军俱乐部杯”更名为“欧洲冠军联赛”后，这是第30个赛季。比赛于2022年5月28日在法国圣但尼法兰西体育场举行，由英格兰利物浦对阵西班牙皇家马德里。

en.s: The 2022 A-League Men Grand Final was the 17th A-League Men Grand Final, the championship-deciding match of the Australian A-League Men and the culmination of the 2021–22 season. The match was played between season premiers and defending champions Melbourne City and Western United on 28 May 2022 at AAMI Park in Melbourne.

zh.t: 2022年澳大利亚职业联赛男子组总决赛

en.t: 2022 Portuguese Social Democratic Party leadership election
en.s: The 2022 Portuguese Social Democratic Party leadership election was held on 28 May 2022. If no candidate achieved more than 50% of the votes in the first round, a second round would be held between the two most voted candidates in the first round on 4 June 2022, however, as only two candidates were on the ballot, Luís Montenegro and Jorge Moreira da Silva, a second round was not necessary.

zh.t: 2022年葡萄牙社会民主党党魁选举

en.s: The 2022 European Rugby Champions Cup Final was the final match of the 2021–22 European Rugby Champions Cup, and the twenty-seventh European club rugby final in general. The final was contested between La Rochelle and Leinster with La Rochelle winning the game with a late try. Despite having hosted a number of Champions Cup semi-finals, the Stade Vélodrome hosted its first European final, two years later than expected after it was rearranged from 2020 due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

zh.s: 2022年欧洲橄榄球冠军杯决赛是2021—22赛季的最后一场比赛，也是欧洲俱乐部橄榄球第27届决赛。参赛双方是拉罗谢尔和伦斯特。拉罗谢尔凭借比赛末段的一次达阵获胜。韦洛德罗姆体育场此前举办过多场冠军杯半决赛，这是它首次承办欧洲决赛；原定于2020年举办的决赛因新冠疫情改期，因此比计划晚了两年。

zh.s: 拉里奥哈于2023年5月28日举行自治区选举，选出该自治区第11届议会，全部33个席位改选。选举与西班牙其他11个自治区的选举及全国各地地方选举同时举行。

en.s: Regional elections were held in Spain during 2023 to elect the regional parliaments of twelve of the seventeen autonomous communities: Aragon, Asturias, the Balearic Islands, the Canary Islands, Cantabria, Castilla–La Mancha, Extremadura, La Rioja, Madrid, Murcia, Navarre and the Valencian Community. 736 of 1,211 seats in the regional parliaments were up for election. The elections were held on 28 May (concurrently with local elections all across the country).

zh.s: 西班牙于2023年举行自治区议会选举，在17个自治区中的12个选出议会：阿拉贡、阿斯图里亚斯、巴利阿里群岛、加那利群岛、坎塔布里亚、卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼恰、埃斯特雷马杜拉、拉里奥哈、马德里、穆尔西亚、纳瓦拉和瓦伦西亚自治区。各自治区议会共1211个席位中的736席进行改选。选举于5月28日举行，与全国各地的地方选举同时进行。

en.s: The 2024 Israeli Labor Party leadership election was held on 28 May 2024 to elect a successor to Merav Michaeli as leader of the Israeli Labor Party. Yair Golan won the election.

zh.s: 以色列工党于2024年5月28日举行党魁选举，选出梅拉夫·米凯利的继任者。亚伊尔·戈兰赢得选举。

en.s: The 2025 UEFA Conference League final was the final match of the 2024–25 UEFA Conference League, the fourth season of Europe's tertiary club football tournament organised by UEFA, and the first season since it was renamed from the UEFA Europa Conference League to the UEFA Conference League. It was played at the Wrocław Stadium in Wrocław, Poland, on 28 May 2025, between Spanish club Real Betis and English club Chelsea.

zh.s: 2025年欧洲协会联赛决赛是2024—25赛季该赛事的最后一场比赛，也是欧足联主办的欧洲第三级别俱乐部赛事第四个赛季。赛事从“欧足联欧洲协会联赛”（UEFA Europa Conference League）更名为“欧足联协会联赛”（UEFA Conference League）后，这是第一个赛季。比赛于2025年5月28日在波兰弗罗茨瓦夫体育场举行，由西班牙皇家贝蒂斯对阵英格兰切尔西。

en.s: The 2025 Maybank Challenge Cup (Malay: Piala Cabaran Maybank) was the charity hybrid friendly match played by the ASEAN All-Stars, a selection team by the ASEAN Football Federation and English Premier League club Manchester United in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. The ASEAN All-Stars won the match 1–0, with Maung Maung Lwin scoring the solitary goal.

zh.s: 2025年Maybank挑战杯是一场公益混合友谊赛，由东盟足球联合会选出的东盟全明星队对阵英格兰足球超级联赛曼联队，比赛在马来西亚吉隆坡举行。东盟全明星队以1比0获胜，毛毛温打入全场唯一进球。
